li.label: my god was good to us
li.description: I saw it, and I believe it was the god I hold to. That god looks after us.

li.label: saw my god with my own eyes
li.description: There was no doubting it this time. I saw the god I pray to, plainly, here among us.

li.label: saw something of the gods
li.description: I saw something today that I can't explain. It stays with me, in a good way.

li.label: saw a god plainly
li.description: I saw something that could only have been a god, as clearly as I see the others here. I keep thinking about it.

li.label: an odd sign
li.description: Something strange happened today, and I don't know what it means. I keep looking over my shoulder.

li.label: something angry was here
li.description: Whatever that was, it was not pleased with us. I would rather not see it again.

li.label: the one I fear came near
li.description: I know what that was, and I am afraid of it. It came close to us today.

li.label: the one I fear showed itself
li.description: I saw the one I dread, plainly, here among us. I can't stop shaking.

li.label: something great happened here
li.description: Everyone is talking about it. Something happened here that people will remember for years.

HistoryEventDef.label: heard of what happened at the colony

HediffDef.label: a good day for growing
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, work with plants comes easily to them, and the harvest from their hands is a little better.

HediffDef.label: warm hands
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, their hands feel warm and sure. Work at the bench and in the rock goes faster.

HediffDef.label: a steady eye
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they move quietly and the animals settle around them. Hunting and handling animals go better.

HediffDef.label: shaking off sickness
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, their body fights off sickness better than usual.

HediffDef.label: easy company
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they are easy to talk to, and strangers warm to them quickly.

HediffDef.label: a feel for machines
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they seem to know what a machine needs before they look. Research and building go better.

HediffDef.label: light on their feet
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they feel light and quick, as if the wind were behind them.

HediffDef.label: at ease in the cold
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, the cold doesn't reach them as it did. They can stand a colder day without feeling it.

HediffDef.label: hearing too much
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, the world sounds louder and closer, and their mind is more open than it was. It doesn't always feel good.

HediffDef.label: sun-warmed
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they feel warmed through and full of energy. Every kind of work goes a little faster.

HediffDef.label: sleeping deeply
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they sleep deeply and wake rested, and their wounds mend faster.

HediffDef.label: calm
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they have been calm and steady. Bad news and pain shake them less.

HediffDef.label: a clean hand in the kitchen
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, the water they draw and the food they cook seem cleaner, and cooking goes a little faster.

HediffDef.label: a good eye for a bargain
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they notice what things are really worth. Traders find them hard to cheat.

HediffDef.label: a light heart
HediffDef.description: Since what they saw, they take more pleasure in everything, and people warm to them easily.

HediffDef.label: frost-hardy
HediffDef.description: Since what happened, the cold has hardly touched them. It has been like that for everyone here.

HediffDef.label: warmed through
HediffDef.description: Since the day every crop shot up in the sun, everyone here has felt warm and strong. Work goes faster.

HediffDef.label: kept calm
HediffDef.description: Since what happened, they have been calm and steady through everything, and pain bothers them less.

HediffDef.label: a bad night
HediffDef.description: After what they saw, they slept badly and woke tired. They will be tired sooner today.
